elements.title: Stagger Button
elements.description: A button that staggers per character or slides the whole label on hover, with a scaling background layer.

elements.name: sticky-scroll-cards
elements.title: Sticky Scroll Cards
elements.description: Scroll-pinned hero where a front card flips to reveal a stack of back cards, dismissed one at a time as you keep scrolling.

elements.name: text-cursor-loop
elements.title: Text Cursor Loop
elements.description: Cycles through a list of words with a per-character collapse/reveal transition and a trailing cursor glyph that wipes across the text between words.

elements.name: text-effect
elements.title: Text Effect
elements.description: Preset-driven staggered text reveals with blur, fade, slide, and scale animations, powered by Motion.

elements.name: text-loop
elements.title: Text Loop
elements.description: Cycles through a list of items with an enter/exit animation, powered by Motion.

elements.name: text-morph
elements.title: Text Morph
elements.description: Per-character layout morphing for labels, counters, and live text swaps, powered by Motion.

elements.name: text-reveal-block
elements.title: Text Reveal (Block)
elements.description: Line-by-line text reveal with a colored block wipe, powered by GSAP SplitText.

elements.name: text-reveal-box
elements.title: Text Reveal Box
elements.description: Scroll-pinned word-by-word text reveal with a highlight flash, powered by GSAP ScrollTrigger.

elements.name: text-reveal-mask
elements.title: Text Reveal (Mask)
elements.description: A scroll-triggered masked slide-up text reveal animation, powered by Motion.

elements.name: text-roll
elements.title: Text Roll
elements.description: A per-character vertical text roll animation for label swaps and micro-interactions, powered by Motion.

elements.name: text-scramble
elements.title: Text Scramble
elements.description: A text scramble reveal animation that decodes characters on mount or when re-triggered, powered by Motion.

elements.name: tilt-card

elements.name: tilt-slide-transition

elements.name: typer
elements.title: Typer
elements.description: A character-by-character reveal where each glyph ripples through randomized pill, accent, and outline states before settling into plain text. Adjacent same-state chars merge into rounded bars, and it's themed entirely through CSS variables.
